select id AS financing_id, duration_FROM AS repay_date, IFNULL(financing_amount,0) AS loan_amount, IFNULL (average_coupon_rate,0) AS comprehensive_interest_rate FROM fund_direct_financing_base_info
union all(
select actual.financing_id AS financing_id, actual.repay_date AS repay_date, IFNULL(base.financing_amount,0) AS loan_amount, IFNULL (plan.comprehensive_interest_rate,0) AS comprehensive_interest_rate
FROM fund_financing_repay_actual actual join ( select min(phase) min_phase,financing_id FROM fund_financing_repay_actual group by financing_id )actual2 ON actual.financing_id = actual2.financing_id and actual.phase = actual2.min_phase join fund_financing_base_info base ON actual.financing_id = base.id join fund_financing_plan plan ON plan.financing_id = base.id )
